children: Overview
Germany building coatings maker's H1 2026 turnover up 3.7% to EUR 805.5 mln
EBIT for H1 2026 rose 20.6% to EUR 30.5 mln
Company maintains full-year 2026 outlook amid market uncertainty
Outlook
Sto SE & Co. KGaA maintains 2026 turnover forecast at EUR 1.62 bln
Company expects 2026 EBIT between EUR 56 mln and EUR 76 mln
Sto says geopolitical risks could drive procurement cost increases and market disruptions
Result Drivers
ADVERSE WEATHER - Co said severe frost, cold, wet conditions and intense heat restricted work on outdoor construction sites, especially in the facade segment
STRATEGIC INITIATIVES - Co said expanding market share and broad market positioning helped offset stagnation or decline in market volume in some countries
PROCUREMENT COST PRESSURE - Co said war in Iran led to price rises on procurement side and freight costs, prompting proactive inventory build-up
